entries.what_was_tested: Standalone paper-repository extraction, privacy, source integrity, numerical replay, document build and failure paths.
entries.methods: 49 deterministic tests in three interpreter modes; independent directory with supplied catalogues and matrices; all 30,000 original permutation-index digests and 780,000 candidate statistics replayed; 945 spatial deletions; 9 mass-bin weighted comparisons; 54 nominal t references and 3 cube summaries.
entries.results: Reproduction passed; maximum checked absolute numerical difference 4.217781679471955e-11. Both v12 PDFs reproduced byte-for-byte with the existing compiler.
entries.failures: No numerical reproduction failure. Three local-path metadata cells were replaced by basenames before qualification; all scientific field strings retained. Private corruption and overwrite fixtures were correctly rejected.
entries.next_steps: Push and verify this new repository only. Complete older-analysis archive coverage and owner-approved licence/visibility decisions before a public release and DOI.
entries.scope: Repository-preparation milestone, not a new scientific experiment or a completed public archive.

entries.what_was_tested: Branch-only audit disposition,32-asset reproduction map, exact available/complete/omitted identity mapping, old numerical byte preservation and failure guards.
entries.methods: 57 deterministic tests in normal/-O/-OO modes;124379 coverage and identity checks; three deliberately invalid metadata fixtures and strict-caller failure test. Recovered legacy materials were separately replayed in the chat workspace with original streams.
entries.results: Reporting actions verified; ABA26-001 and ABA26-002 scientifically OPEN. All32 assets mapped. Available62073,complete48556,omitted13517 with zero imputed epochs. Existing manuscript and numerical payload unchanged. Legacy companion verified but transfer into this repository remains pending.
entries.failures: Local archival selection initially named original111.py instead of the actual original111.py.txt member; the attempt stopped and was retained, then exact member selection was repaired before successful replay. No scientific value, stream or criterion changed. Intentional metadata-corruption fixtures were rejected.
entries.next_steps: Transfer the verified55.45-MB legacy companion for additive import and clean-checkout replay; finish remaining explicit provenance/secondary-runner coverage, owner licence/redistribution decision, public visibility and an archival DOI. No new inference campaign or v176 authorized.

entries.what_was_tested: Verified additive import of the recovered older-analysis companion, full original-stream replay, combined public checkout interface, file preservation and safe failure behavior.
entries.methods: 239 exact companion files; 77 tests in normal/-O/-OO; 15 formation grids and 9 threshold grids; all 468,000 archived candidate statistics; 27 recorded-loss fits; all 360,000 archived minima in 36 separate cross-checks. Combined main and companion default replay also passed.
entries.results: All required import gates passed. Maximum legacy numerical difference 3.865352482534945e-12. Existing scientific and paper files remain byte-exact. Public visibility was changed by the owner and verified; no release was published by this step.
entries.failures: An attempted metadata-script construction had a quoting SyntaxError before executing or writing a script. It was retained and repaired by direct heredoc execution; numerical code, data, seeds and thresholds were unchanged. Deliberate private corruptions were rejected.
entries.next_steps: Verify push and anonymous fresh-clone replay. Obtain licence and redistribution decisions, approve the explicit reproduction scope and finalize release metadata after the owner enables Zenodo. Publish an approved release only with separate authorization and verify its actual DOI.

entries.what_was_tested: Owner-selected MIT code and CC BY 4.0 figure scope; exact legal text, file identities, bounds and failure paths.
entries.methods: Manifest and import checks; explicit material map; 85 deterministic tests in normal/-O/-OO modes; unauthorized dataset-grant fixture and strict-caller corrupt-licence fixture.
entries.results: MIT assigned to 28 original source/script files; CC BY 4.0 assigned to eight original figures in 24 representations. Prior source, scientific data, figures and manuscript bytes unchanged.
entries.failures: Initial precommit whitespace check rejected a terminal blank line in the official CC legal-code download. Only surplus terminal newlines were removed; legal text tokens unchanged. All gates rechecked before commit. Deliberately invalid private fixtures were rejected.
entries.next_steps: Resolve manuscript/documentation and standalone dataset rights/licensing; approve the complete release scope and upstream redistribution; only then publish an approved tagged release and verify its Zenodo DOI.

entries.what_was_tested: Author clarification: original code MIT; all other author-owned material CC BY 4.0.
entries.methods: Material-scope validator; 95 deterministic tests in normal/-O/-OO modes; input/legacy/coverage checks; altered-policy and legal-text failure fixtures; strict-shell preservation; existing-file hashes.
entries.results: MIT retained for all 28 original source/scripts. CC BY 4.0 extended to all non-code author contributions including manuscript, documentation, figures, tables, metadata, datasets and analytical outputs. Existing third-party rights and legal texts preserved. Scientific routines, inputs, outputs and manuscript PDF bytes unchanged.
entries.failures: No failed implementation gate. Intentional third-party relicensing, wrong code licence and altered legal text were rejected.
entries.next_steps: Verify the licensing commit and push. Complete upstream redistribution review and approved archival-release metadata; publish a release only after separate approval and verify its DOI.
